credits.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part II)
credits.overview: Third and final film in the Kaamelott franchise.

credits.title: Cassandre - Les inconnus du Sapenay
credits.overview: Spring reveals the secrets buried under the Sapenay pass, overlooking Lake Annecy. As the snow melts, a hiker discovers in a cave the body of a woman, killed by a bullet through the heart. Near this still anonymous victim, two other bodies, men, lie under the snow, frozen for years.

credits.title: The Money Maker
credits.overview: A Polish engineer relocates to France and becomes a legendary counterfeiter. Working solo, he crafts flawless fake francs worth millions over 14 years, earning the nickname "Cézanne of counterfeit money" for his artistic skill and output.

credits.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part I)
credits.overview: After reclaiming Kaamelott from Lancelot's tyrannical rule, Arthur spares his life, defying Celtic gods. Knights must prove themselves for Table Round seats while Arthur faces new threats as king.

credits.title: Cours !
credits.overview: 1967. Nicole is training for a marathon under the watchful eye of her coach. However, the race organizers are not keen on having a woman among the participants.

credits.title: Kaamelott: The First Chapter
credits.overview: Hidden in Rome, King Arthur is planning his return to oppose the army of his former friend Lancelot.

credits.title: The Rose Maker
credits.overview: Eve used to be one of the most famous rose creators in the world. Today, her company is on the verge of bankruptcy. On top of that, her secretary Vera has hired three outcasts with absolutely no gardening skills.
